name: calm-typescript
description: Спокойные ошибки JS/TS, плавный курсор и мягкая подсветка после Ctrl+S.

commands.title: Calm TypeScript: Reset Managed Editor Settings

calmTypeScript.quietMode.description: Show diagnostics on every affected line at 80% transparency, including Error Lens text. Validation, IntelliSense and build checks stay enabled.

calmTypeScript.smoothTyping.description: Enable native smooth caret animation, smooth blinking and scrolling.

calmTypeScript.typingPulse.description: Briefly highlight the latest newly typed character without changing source text.

calmTypeScript.savePulse.description: After a manual save (Ctrl+S), softly highlight the cursor lines for 300 ms. Auto Save stays silent.
